channel.description: Latest articles from Independent Journal review (ijr.com)

item.title: MTG Says Trump Isn’t A Real Christian
item.description: Republican Georgia Rep. Marjorie Taylor Greene told The New York Times that President Donald Trump has proven to have no Christian faith.

item.title: ‘My Friends Will Get Hurt’: MTG Alleges Trump Raged At Her During Epstein Battle
item.description: Republican Georgia Rep. Marjorie Taylor Greene alleged President Donald Trump told her, "My friends will get hurt" if she identified the abusers in the Epstein Files, according to The New York Times Monday.

item.title: Squalid, State-Licensed ‘Day Care’ Has Listed Phone Number Taking You To Tim Walz’s Office
item.description: A child care center licensed under Democratic Minnesota Gov. Tim Walz's administration raised eyebrows by having a publicly listed phone number leading to Walz's office.

item.title: Former Top Grid Official Sounds Alarm Over Trump Data Center Proposal
item.description: Mark Christie, formerly a top power grid regulator, is warning that a proposal that's part of the Trump administration's push to fast-track artificial intelligence (AI) data center proliferation will have unintended consequences.

item.title: MTG Vows To Be Crusader Against MAGA World’s Fixation With Fake Boobs, Lip Fillers
item.description: Republican Georgia Rep. Marjorie Taylor Greene said she has always been uncomfortable with what she deemed the “MAGA Mar-a-Lago sexualization” of women and vowed to speak out more on the subject, according to a New York Times interview published Monday.

item.title: MTG Alleges Mike Johnson Is Puppet Being Controlled By Trump’s White House
item.description: Republican Georgia Rep. Marjorie Taylor Greene alleged Speaker of the House Mike Johnson has no say in President Donald Trump's agenda, and is instead directed to act as a rubber stamp for the White House, the New York Times reported Monday.

item.title: GORDON CHANG: China’s TikTok Deal Great For China, Not For America
item.description: TikTok has posed two national security threats. First, TikTok and its owner ByteDance have repeatedly made promises about the security of personal data of Americans, but they have not honored pledges and have broken U.S. statutes. The company settled charges that it violated U.S. child privacy laws.

item.title: Foreigners Scheme To Keep Their H-1Bs As Trump Admin Throttles Cheap Labor Pipeline
item.description: Temporary Indian workers sidelined by the Trump administration's tighter vetting policies are organizing by the thousands to keep the pipeline of cheap, foreign labor flowing.

item.title: JENNY BETH MARTIN: President Trump’s First Year Of His Second Term Got Results
item.description: President Donald Trump’s return to the White House has been marked not by vague pronouncements but by measurable outcomes. On the economy, at the border, in matters of law and order, and in foreign policy, his first 11 months in office have shown – a point too often overlooked – that conservative leadership still matters.

item.title: MANDY GUNASEKARA: Europe’s Green Agenda Continues To Pick America’s Pocket
item.description: President Donald Trump has made significant progress in fixing America’s broken economy. After inheriting a total mess with rampant inflation, expensive groceries, and home ownership becoming out of reach, most Americans can now see that the economic nightmare of the Biden Administration is coming to an end.
